newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Banco Ganadero still No. 1 in assets.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Banco Ganadero still No. 1 in assets.

text.p: Colombia's Banco Ganadero retained its No. 1 ranking in terms of assets during the first half of 1996, the Banking Superintendency said.
It said Ganadero's assets as of June 30, 1996, stood at 3.27 trillion pesos, a 30 percent increase from the close of the first half in 1995.
The bank's liabilities increased proportionately, however, rising 29.4 percent from June 30, 1995 to 2.77 trillion pesos on June 30, 1996.
The Banking Superintendency said Banco de Colombia was Colombia's second largest bank in terms of assets at the close of the first half, with a reported total of 2.66 trillion pesos.
